verdict.rationale: The docs show official first-party SDKs for specific Issuing features: an Authentication SDK for out-of-band 3D Secure authentication, and iOS SDKs for revealing card details and changing PINs. The core Issuing operations (creating payment instruments, managing cards, disputes) are documented only as raw API requests, with no evidence of official server-side SDKs. Missing for 10: official server-side SDKs/API libraries covering the core Issuing API, a list of supported languages, Android/web SDK coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
